CustomField.description: [peoplesoft] - Formula field that displays whether or not the Contact__r.Visa_Type__c contains F1 or J1 visa types.
CustomField.formula: IF(INCLUDES( Contact.Visa_Type__c, "F1"), "F1" + BR(), NULL)+ IF(INCLUDES( Contact.Visa_Type__c, "J1"), "J1", NULL)
CustomField.label: Student Visa
